item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 18/Jul/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A broad trough of low pressure over the central and northern parts of the South China Sea will bring showers and thunderstorms to the coast of southern China in the next couple of days. With an anticyclone aloft strengthening gradually, the weather will improve and will be very hot over Guangdong from the latter part of this week to early next week. The area of low pressure now over the seas east of the Philippines is expected to develop into a tropical cyclone, entering the northern part of the South China Sea early next week and may intensify into a stronger tropical cyclone, edging closer to the vicinity of the coast of southern China. It will be windy with squally showers over the region midweek next week. However, its movement remains uncertain.
